questions.stem: A circular buffer has 6 slots numbered 0 to 5, and the rear is at slot 5. The next rear slot is computed as (rear + 1) % 6. What is it?
questions.explain: 5 + 1 = 6 and 6 % 6 = 0, so the index wraps back to slot 0.

questions.stem:
What does this program print?

```python
i = 0
while i < 10:
    i += 4
print(i)
```
questions.explain: i goes 0, 4, 8, 12. At 12 the test i < 10 fails, so it prints 12.

questions.stem: An array holds 100 items in positions 0 to 99. The item at position 0 is removed and every later item is shifted one place left. How many items are moved?
questions.explain: Positions 1 to 99 each move left once, which is 99 moves. That is why removing from the front of an array costs O(n).
